# Keys the shared nav (https://cutout-z.github.io/aemo-dashboards/nav.js) knows: the `key:` of each item in
# its DASHBOARDS array, plus nothing else (`home` is the aemo-dashboards overview and no dashboard page sends it).
# Source: cutout-z/aemo-dashboards nav.js. The pages load that URL from Pages `main`, which moves, so this is a
# copy. Refresh after a dashboard is added or renamed:
#   grep -o "key: '[^']*'" <aemo-dashboards checkout>/nav.js | cut -d"'" -f2
# aemo-dashboards' own tests/test_nav_links.py fails if nav.js and its list of keys disagree.
